class.rpgplayable.warrior.description: Tough frontline fighter. Heavy Strike, Charge and Ground Slam consume stamina.
class.rpgplayable.mage.description: Arcane caster. Firebolt, Arcane Burst and Blink consume mana.
class.rpgplayable.rogue.description: Fast skirmisher. Dash, Backstab and Fan of Knives consume stamina.
stat.rpgplayable.strength.description: Raises melee damage and mining speed.
stat.rpgplayable.intelligence.descriptio: Raises spell power and maximum mana.
stat.rpgplayable.spirit.description: Raises resource regeneration and support power.

screen.rpgplayable.guide.tooltip: Learn your abilities, targeting, controls and progression.
screen.rpgplayable.keybinds.tooltip: Change Character and ability keys in the RPG Playable category.
screen.rpgplayable.choose_first: Choose a class in Character to unlock abilities
screen.rpgplayable.basics.1: Choose a permanent class. Each level earns one point for any of the five stats.
screen.rpgplayable.basics.2: Defeat hostile mobs in Survival or Adventure to earn RPG XP. Spend points in Character.
screen.rpgplayable.basics.3: Abilities target hostile mobs. Aim before casting; walls block attacks and travel.
screen.rpgplayable.basics.4: Mana and stamina refill over time. Wait for wind-up, recovery and cooldown.
screen.rpgplayable.basics.5: Casting spends resources immediately. A missed or interrupted ability still costs resources.
ability.rpgplayable.heavy_strike.descrip: Sweep hostile mobs in a wide cone up to 3.5 blocks ahead. Face the group as the strike lands. Strength increases damage.
ability.rpgplayable.charge.description: Rush forward up to 5 blocks, damaging and knocking back mobs along your path. Start on the ground, unmounted, with a clear path and safe footing.
ability.rpgplayable.ground_slam.descript: Strike the ground to damage and push away nearby mobs within 4 blocks at a similar height. Requires solid ground and no mount. Strength increases damage.
ability.rpgplayable.firebolt.description: Aim to launch a firebolt at a hostile mob. It stops at the first mob or wall. Intelligence increases spell damage. Lead moving targets.
ability.rpgplayable.arcane_burst.descrip: Damage visible hostile mobs within 4 blocks around you. Hitting at least one mob also heals you. Intelligence boosts damage; Spirit boosts healing.
ability.rpgplayable.blink.description: Teleport forward up to 7 blocks along a clear path. Needs a safe supported landing and no mount. Walls stop travel; looking up does not raise the landing.
ability.rpgplayable.dash.description: Dash forward up to 4.5 blocks, then gain a brief speed boost. Needs a clear path, safe footing and no mount. Spirit extends the speed boost.
ability.rpgplayable.backstab.description: Strike the nearest hostile mob in front within 3 blocks. Attack from behind the target for 1.8× damage. Strength and Agility increase damage.
ability.rpgplayable.fan_of_knives.descri: Aim to throw five knives in a spread. Knives hit hostile mobs once per volley and stop at walls. Strength and Agility increase damage.
screen.rpgplayable.class_select.subtitle: Choose a path. Preview each class below.
screen.rpgplayable.permanent_warning: Permanent choice — confirm when you are ready.
screen.rpgplayable.preview_hint: Select a card to preview, then confirm.
screen.rpgplayable.confirm_narration: Permanently choose %s. This choice cannot be changed.
screen.rpgplayable.preview_narration: Preview %s. %s. Uses %s. %s. %s. %s. Confirm below to choose permanently.
screen.rpgplayable.example.warrior: Charge into a group, then follow with Heavy Strike or Ground Slam.
screen.rpgplayable.example.mage: Firebolt at range, Blink to safety, or heal while landing Arcane Burst.
screen.rpgplayable.example.rogue: Dash behind a foe for Backstab, or aim a spread of knives at a group.
screen.rpgplayable.effects_note: Current totals include class bonuses and server tuning.

screen.rpgplayable.profile_hint: Defeat hostile mobs to earn XP and new stat points.
